instruction: Studio portrait photograph, full shot, front view. In an indoor studio with a draped beige fabric backdrop, three generations of women pose together. In the background, the older woman with short dark hair (R1) sits upright in a white shirt, smiling at the camera. In the middle ground, the younger woman with medium-length brown hair (R2) sits with legs spread wide in a white shirt and blue jeans, looking down at the child. In the foreground, the little girl with light brown hair (R3) sits between R2's legs in a white blouse and light blue jeans, looking slightly left. R1's hands rest on R2's shoulders, while R2 wraps her arms around R3's torso. Soft, diffused studio lighting creates a warm, neutral-toned atmosphere.
